title: Product Map re-bucketing over the review-surface tree model
description: Pure functions groupByShape, groupByComponent, groupByTraceCoverage, groupByCapability, groupByBlueprint plus the panel renderer that composes them. No schema change; consumes shapeClassification.shapes[], usByTacId, tsByAcId/tcsByAcId, REQ.tags[] for capability:<slug> tags, and manifest.blueprints[].contributions[] for blueprint attribution (fallback: reqId kebab-slug prefix). Emits a pm-blueprint-badge on every REQ row an applied blueprint contributed.
